run_adversarial_attack: run adversarial text attacks on a dataset using BAE, BERT-Attack, or custom attack methods
run_bae_attack: run the BAE adversarial attack on a text classification dataset with a configurable cosine threshold
run_bert_attack: run the BERT-Attack adversarial attack on a text classification dataset using masked language model swaps
run_clare_attack: run the CLARE adversarial attack on a text classification dataset using embedding-based word swaps
run_custom_attack: run a custom adversarial attack with targeted or untargeted classification goal functions on text data
